target.title: fix(feishu): preserve text when replies include media
target.body:
Closes #102390

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu users would lose the visible text from an assistant final reply when that reply also included a regular `MEDIA:` attachment while streaming cards were active. The channel could finish with only the no-visible-content fallback instead of showing the assistant's text alongside the attachment.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Feishu streaming reply path now closes the active final streaming card before dispatching regular media attachments. That keeps the final text on the visible streaming-card path while preserving the existing separate media send behavior and the voice-media text suppression path.

AI-assisted.

## User Impact

Feishu replies that combine text with an image or other regular attachment now keep the assistant's text visible and still send the attachment. Users should no longer see the misleading "reply completed without visible content" fallback for this text-plus-media streaming reply shape.

## Evidence

Source-level before/premise: on current main, the active streaming branch updated the final text and then returned after media dispatch without closing the streaming card in that branch. Feishu media sending does not carry a caption parameter, so the text needed to be made visible through the streaming card path rather than through media upload.

After fix:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` -> 87 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo` -> passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` -> passed.
- `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` -> passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base refs/remotes/upstream/main` -> clean, no accepted/actionable findings.

I did not run a live Feishu client smoke in this checkout. The focused regression test exercises the dispatcher path directly: final text plus regular media now closes the streaming card, sends the attachment, and does not send the no-visible-reply fallback.
